root.message: I can help with login issues. What's happening?

options.label: I'm not receiving the verification email

forgot_password.message: You can reset your password by clicking 'Forgot Password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email address within a few minutes.

account_locked.message: Accounts are temporarily locked after 5 failed login attempts. The lock lifts automatically after 15 minutes. If you are still locked out after that, raise a ticket and our team will help.

no_verify_email.message: Verification emails can take up to 5 minutes. Please check your spam/junk folder. You can also request a new one from the login page.
